title: Original public Git source carrier input

operationId.description: The original stable operation identity. Reuse it for every continuation.

repository.description: The original public GitHub owner/repository. New carrier objects stay in this repository.

commit.description: The exact original source commit, never a moving branch alias.

pageId.description: The authorized existing Notion destination; required before publication. An adopted completed state can already supply it.

branchPrefix.description: Unique source-only branch prefix; the original part number is appended. Git ref syntax is validated by the producer.

filenamePrefix.description: Unique source filename prefix, preferably including the exact commit identity.

maxSourceBytes.description: Original uncompressed source bytes per part. The actual resulting ZIP is checked against the 5 MiB attachment profile.

commitFile.description: Complete original Git commit API response text. Relative paths resolve beside this input file.

treeFile.description: Complete original recursive Git tree API response text with truncated:false.

attributeFiles.description: Map each original .gitattributes Git path to its exact local UTF-8 source file. The producer checks its Git blob SHA.

retainedStateFile.description: An existing exact stellar-forge.git-source-carrier-state.v1 file. Adoption preserves all original returned IDs.
